verse.verse_1: By the heaven, and the night-visitor,
verse.verse_2: what do you know what the night-visitor is?
verse.verse_4: There is no living being but there is a protector over it.
verse.verse_5: So let man consider of what he was created.
verse.verse_6: He was created of a gushing fluid,
verse.verse_7: emanating from between the loins and the ribs.
verse.verse_8: Surely He (the Creator) has the power to bring him back (to life).
verse.verse_9: On the Day when man's deepest secrets shall be put to the test
verse.verse_10: he shall have no power, and no helper.
verse.verse_11: By the heaven with its recurring cycle of rain,
verse.verse_12: and by the earth ever bursting with verdure,
verse.verse_13: this (Qur'an) is surely a decisive Word,
verse.verse_16: and I too am devising a guile.
verse.verse_17: So leave the unbelievers to themselves; respite them awhile.
